transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Yeah, I came in because since I moved into this busted-up room, I’ve just been… not handling things right. I’m snapping at people over small stuff, staying up trying to fix leaks or deal with the heat, and then I’m dragging myself into work late. I’m messing up things I normally know how to do.
Have you noticed that you’re not enjoying things you normally like to do, like hobbies or spending time with friends?

I don’t know, I haven’t really noticed that. I mean, I haven’t been doing much lately, but I can’t say it’s because I don’t enjoy it. It’s more like I just haven’t had the chance or the energy to think about that.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, since moving into this place?
I’m not sure I’d call it depressed most of the day, nearly every day. I’ve been upset and worn down by the place, yeah, but I haven’t really been tracking it like that.
Have you found that you’re not interested in doing things you usually like, such as hobbies or spending time with friends, since moving into this place?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed that I don’t like those things anymore. I just haven’t been doing much since moving in, so it’s hard to tell.
Have you felt a loss of interest in things you usually care about or enjoy, like work, hobbies, or being around people?
I don’t think so, not in a clear way. I mean, I haven’t been doing as much, but I can’t really say I stopped caring about those things. It’s more like I just haven’t been focused on them lately.
Would you say that your mood has been consistently low or that you've felt little pleasure in life since moving into this place, even when things unrelated to the move are happening?

I don’t think I can say it’s been consistently low like that. I’ve been stressed about the move and the place, but I still have moments where I’m okay. I haven’t really noticed that I feel no pleasure in life overall.
Would you say that most of your struggles since moving in have been a reaction to the stress of the situation, like dealing with the broken room and trying to manage everything at once?

Yeah, I’d say that’s pretty much it. Since I moved into that busted-up room, everything’s been piling on. I’m snapping at people, staying up trying to deal with leaks or the heat, and then I’m dragging myself into work late and messing up things I normally handle fine.

Would you say that your mood or behavior has been significantly affected even in times when you’re not actively dealing with the problems in your room, or does it seem to only come up when you're dealing with those stressors?

It mostly comes up around the room and everything that’s come with it. Like, since I moved into that busted-up place, I’ve been snapping at people, staying up dealing with leaks or the heat, and then I’m late to work and messing up stuff I usually handle fine. When I’m not thinking about it or dealing with it, I’m not as bad, but it kind of follows me because there’s always something with that room.

Would you say that all of your symptoms—like being irritable, having trouble focusing, and feeling overwhelmed—only happen when you’re dealing with or thinking about the issues related to your new room, or do they also come up in other parts of your life that aren’t related to the move?

It’s mostly tied to the room and the mess from moving in there. Like, since I got into that busted-up place, I’m snapping at people, staying up dealing with leaks or the heat, and then I’m dragging into work late and messing up things I’d normally handle. It kind of spills over into work, but it feels like it starts with all that room stuff.
